name: Shelly EM Mini Gen4
summary: Tiny inline 16 A single-circuit energy meter (no relay) with Wi-Fi, Zigbee, Matter, BLE gateway.

extra.measurement: inline (load current passes through device), not a CT
extra.job_note: meter_circuit used although it does not switch the load

gotchas: No relay — measures only, can't switch; see Shelly 1PM Mini Gen4 for switch+meter
Inline 16 A / 3840 W through the module, not a clamp — not for panel/whole-home; see Shelly Pro 3EM-3CT63
Active power/energy only (no reactive/PF reporting listed)
KB spec is the EU model (S4EM-001PXCEU16); no UL listing stated
best_for: Metering a single appliance or branch circuit ≤16 A from inside a box
